scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The result provides two explicit nontrivial square-cobalancing indices for one primitive pair with right coefficient greater than one. It does not claim coefficient minimality, full integral-point classification, or uniqueness. Previously published OEIS A374500 already implies a weaker example with right coefficient one and an index equal to one; that weaker existence claim is not presented as original. The two indices are established by exact integer equalities; independent external validation has not been performed.
title: A primitive non-unit-weight square-cobalancing collision on a genus-one cubic
